name: prd-v08-changelog-as-marketing
description: Design the changelog as a distribution surface bridging engineering releases (DEP-/FEA-) to marketing channels (GTM-) during PRD v0.8 Deployment & Ops. Triggers on requests to set up a changelog system, publish releases, or when user asks "how should we publish releases?", "changelog as marketing", "release notes", "Stripe-style changelog", "what to do with our release notes", "ship and tell". Outputs MON-CHG-* changelog entries and per-channel formats.
